jordan: Heads-up — prototype for the new workspace form. Thinking hybrid: inline errors on field blur + a compact, sticky summary at the top on submit. Thoughts? priya: Love the hybrid. Inline gives immediate feedback; summary catches anything missed and is helpful on mobile where fields get scrolled out. sam: +1. Quick question about required markers — accessibility guidance leans toward visible text ('required') instead of only an asterisk. Can we do an asterisk visually but surface an accessible label for screen readers? lia: I prefer the visual asterisk for density, but agree we must include an sr-only "required" and `aria-required="true"`. Example I use: ```
Please enter a valid phone number
``` aria: Important: inline errors that appear after blur should be announced to screen readers. Use `role="alert"` or `aria-live="assertive"` on the error node and ensure focus management doesn't hide the message. Also ensure the error element is referenced by `aria-describedby` on the form control when appropriate. jordan: For timing — show inline on blur for fields the user interacts with, but don't show all inline errors on initial load. Only surface the compact summary after a submit attempt. Edge case: if someone tabs quickly through many fields we shouldn't flood them with errors. priya: Agreed. Implementation idea: touched/onBlur + validate; debounce validation (200–300ms) to avoid flicker when typing. sam: Destructive action question: delete workspace flow — typed confirm (type the workspace name) vs modal with checkbox + secondary undo. Which level gets which pattern? lia: My take: typed confirm for org- or workspace-level deletion (high risk). It adds friction but reduces accidental deletes. For lower-risk deletes (single resource), checkbox + clear copy is fine. aria: Accessibility note for typed confirm: make sure the modal focuses the input, provide clear instructions, and use `aria-describedby` to connect the instruction copy. Also expose the typed-confirm value in analytics only as a boolean (not the actual name). jordan: Copy nit: modal heading = "Permanently delete workspace". Body = "This action cannot be undone. Type the workspace name to confirm." Primary CTA = "Delete workspace" (red). Secondary CTA = "Cancel". Keep message concise. priya: Mobile concern: typed confirm input feels heavy on mobile. Consider using a checkbox + an extra confirmation tap for medium-risk items on small screens. Or show typed confirm only on larger viewports. sam: We should track metrics: add an event `form.validation.mode` with values `inline|summary|hybrid` on submit and `form.delete.confirmation_type` for delete flows. That will help us detect regressions in form completion rates. lia: Tiny visual nit: if the required asterisk is red, ensure it meets contrast with the background or accompany it with text. We can't use low-contrast red-only markers. jordan: @lia can you mock up two Figma frames: blur-led inline states + top compact banner summary (desktop & mobile)? One with typed-confirm modal, one with checkbox flow. ETA? lia: I'll do two frames and export the variants. ETA EOD tomorrow. design-bot: Note: protos/design/blur-led-inline.v2 exported to the repo. priya: Summary consensus: default to hybrid (inline-on-blur + compact summary on submit), typed confirm for high-risk deletes, checkbox+double-confirm for medium risk on mobile, accessibility rules: use `role="alert"`/`aria-live`, `aria-required`, `aria-describedby`, and ensure contrast + focus management. jordan: Perfect. I'll write a tiny RFC capturing the rules + metrics and slot it into the sprint. Thanks all :thumbsup:
